facts.fact: EMARKETER reports that 38% of US marketing decision makers planned to increase their DOOH budget in 2024.
facts.quote: According to [EMARKETER](https://content-na1.emarketer.com/dooh-ads-drive-action-people-who-view-them), 38% of US marketing decision makers planned to up their DOOH budget in 2024

facts.fact: EMARKETER projects US ad spend on DOOH to increase by 11.2%.
facts.quote: with US ad spend projected to increase by 11.2%

facts.fact: DOOH makes up roughly 15% of total OOH ad inventory, according to EMARKETER.
facts.quote: Although only comprising roughly 15% of total OOH ad inventory

facts.fact: In an OAAA and The Harris Poll study, 76% of respondents reported taking an action after seeing a DOOH ad.
facts.quote: 76% of respondents reported taking an action after seeing a DOOH ad

facts.fact: In the OAAA and Harris Poll study, 38% of respondents reported watching a video after seeing a DOOH ad.
facts.quote: such as watching a video (38%)

facts.fact: In the OAAA and Harris Poll study, 36% of respondents reported going to a restaurant after seeing a DOOH ad.
facts.quote: going to a restaurant (36%)

facts.fact: In the OAAA and Harris Poll study, 30% of respondents reported making a purchase after seeing a DOOH ad.
facts.quote: making a purchase (30%)

facts.fact: In the OAAA and Harris Poll study, 29% of respondents reported visiting a store after seeing a DOOH ad.
facts.quote: visiting a store (29%)

facts.fact: 83.7% of US retail spending happens in-store, per EMARKETER.
facts.quote: With [83.7%](https://content-na1.emarketer.com/dooh-ads-drive-action-people-who-view-them) of US retail spending happening in-store

facts.fact: Programmatic DOOH is projected to account for 30% of all DOOH sales the year after 2025 (2026).
facts.quote: accounting for 30% of all DOOH sales the following year.

facts.fact: CPMs for DOOH often range between $2 and $15, depending on screen type, location, and campaign scope, per StackAdapt.
facts.quote: CPMs for DOOH often range between $2 to $15, depending on the screen type, location, and campaign scope

facts.fact: Smaller screens in high-traffic locations such as bus shelters, convenience stores, and elevators can still offer strong visibility, often at a lower CPM, according to StackAdapt.
facts.quote: But smaller screens in high-traffic locations, such as bus shelters, convenience stores, and elevators, can still offer strong visibility, often at a lower CPM.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that DOOH cost is influenced by several factors, including location, traffic volume, demographics, billboard size, campaign duration, timing, and seasonality.
facts.quote: several factors—including the location, traffic volume, demographics, billboard size, campaign duration, timing, and seasonality—that can influence

facts.fact: StackAdapt says a shopping mall screen would likely cost more to book in the lead-up to the holidays than over the summer months because of higher foot traffic.
facts.quote: a screen in a shopping mall would likely be more expensive

facts.fact: StackAdapt says advertisers are often willing to pay a premium for DOOH ads in high-visibility areas such as popular shopping destinations and downtown cores.
facts.quote: Advertisers are often willing to pay a premium for DOOH ads in high-visibility areas like popular shopping destinations and downtown cores.

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes DOOH impressions as tracked by the number of unique devices passing by an ad.
facts.quote: impressions tracked by the number of unique devices passing by an ad

facts.fact: StackAdapt notes DOOH is a one-to-many channel with no tracking pixel to confirm whether a creative was played.
facts.quote: there’s no tracking pixel to know if your creative was played or not

facts.fact: StackAdapt says DOOH is one of the few unskippable ad formats because viewers cannot easily avoid it in real-world environments.
facts.quote: making DOOH advertising one of the few unskippable ad formats out there.

facts.fact: StackAdapt says advertisers can place DOOH ads in contextually relevant locations by targeting venue types and geographic areas, such as a specific geo-radius.
facts.quote: advertisers can place DOOH ads in contextually relevant locations by targeting venue types and geographic areas to drive conversions

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that a billboard in Toronto's Yonge-Dundas Square would probably cost more than a digital screen in a shopping mall because of the high number of people passing by.
facts.quote: a billboard in Toronto’s Yonge-Dundas Square would probably be more expensive than a digital screen in a shopping mall
